detail: Semavi Eyice documents the mosque completed in 1800, the 16 m central dome and eight supporting exedras, four corner domes, five domes over the portico, two four-bay courtyard arcades and transition to the eight-sided tomb.
National culture inventory describes the current complex, lead-colored dome groups, two minarets and the historic tomb.
The borough inventory specifies the three-window sebil next to the tomb, separated by four marble columns.
The district’s site inventory distinguishes this mosque and tomb from the surrounding independently named historic structures.
